home.metaTitle: ControlMiles — Mileage tracking for gig drivers & fleets
home.metaDescription: GPS trip tracking, odometer verification, and automatic gig-app detection for gig drivers and the fleets managing them.
home.subtitle: Built for gig drivers and fleet companies alike — GPS trip tracking, odometer verification, and automatic gig-app detection that tracks multiple gig apps at once, switching between them dynamically as you drive.
home.routeAlt: An animated route line ending at a ControlMiles pin

stats.statesLabel: Real boundary data for IFTA mileage
stats.guessworkLabel: Every trip is GPS-logged and locked in

features.title: Built to survive an audit, not just a glance.
features.detectionBody: Runs multiple gig apps at once and switches between them dynamically as you drive, detecting and excluding anything that looks faked or spoofed.
features.odometerBody: Snap a photo at start and end — we read the number automatically, so your mileage has real proof behind it, not just a GPS guess.
features.recordBody: Every trip is locked in the moment it's logged. If anything about it ever changes afterward, it shows up right away.
features.fleetBody: Roster, vehicle assignment, DVIR inspections, live location and geofence alerts — one place for an admin to see the whole fleet.

how.title: How it works
how.driveBody: The app tracks miles per gig app automatically, purpose and all.
how.reviewBody: Every trip, purpose, and mile shows up in your history and PDF reports.
how.proveBody: Share a one-time code — a preparer verifies your report, no account needed.

pricing.metaDescription: Simple pricing for gig drivers and fleets. Mileage tracking, odometer verification and audit-ready reports.
pricing.title: Simple pricing, either way you drive.
pricing.subtitle: Individual gig drivers subscribe from the app. Fleet admins manage billing and rostering from this dashboard.
pricing.forDriversNote: Billed in-app on the App Store or Google Play. Cancel anytime.
pricing.forFleetsNote: Priced per vehicle. Set up and manage entirely from controlmiles.com.

portalCta.title: Preparing someone's taxes?
portalCta.body: Your client generates a one-time access code from their ControlMiles account. Enter it here to view a read-only mileage summary — no login, no account, nothing installed.
portalCta.note: For deduction purposes — not guaranteed by this app.
